top_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Ruling on the Right Against Climate Change Effects
top_current_affairs.syllabus_mapping: GS Paper II (Judiciary & Fundamental Rights) & GS Paper III (Environment)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court recognized the right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change as a distinct fundamental right under Article 21 (Right to Life) and Article 14 (Right to Equality).
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Expands the scope of environmental jurisprudence in India, linking climate action directly to fundamental rights.

top_current_affairs.title: RBI's Surplus Transfer to the Central Government
top_current_affairs.syllabus_mapping: GS Paper III (Indian Economy and Issues Relating to Planning, Mobilization of Resources)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record dividend/surplus transfer to the Union Government, aided by higher interest income on foreign assets and prudent economic capital framework management.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Helps fiscal consolidation efforts and provides additional capital for public capital expenditure without increasing the fiscal deficit.

top_current_affairs.title: Progress on the Gaganyaan Mission & Human Spaceflight Centre
top_current_affairs.syllabus_mapping: GS Paper III (Awareness in the fields of Space)
top_current_affairs.summary: ISRO successfully completed key drogue parachute deployment tests and crew module integration milestones for the upcoming uncrewed Gaganyaan (G1) flight.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: India moves closer to becoming the 4th nation to independently launch humans into space, boosting domestic deep-tech manufacturing.

top_current_affairs.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Developments
top_current_affairs.syllabus_mapping: GS Paper II (Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings and Agreements involving India)
top_current_affairs.summary: Inter-governmental discussions continue on finalizing operational frameworks for the IMEC, focusing on multi-modal transit networks, energy pipelines, and digital connectivity.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Serves as a strategic counter-weight to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) and enhances India's trade integration with West Asia and Europe.

top_current_affairs.title: Conservation Status and Recovery Plan for the Great Indian Bustard (GIB)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court appointed an expert committee to assess the feasibility of undergrounding powerlines in Rajasthan and Gujarat to prevent GIB electrocution deaths while balancing renewable energy goals.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Highlights the delicate balance between sustainable green energy expansion (solar/wind) and critically endangered species protection.
